data.name: Negative Space
data.detailed_description:
Negative Space is a 3D Open World exploration platformer where movement and discovery bring a lifeless world back to life.

Set within the mind of a coma patient, you play as a newly formed thought, the first sign of creativity in months. The world around you is empty, silent, and colorless… but wherever you go, color follows.

As you explore, your presence restores form, revealing hidden paths, environments, and memories long buried beneath the surface.

Encounter other frozen thoughts, help them complete their stories, and gather Core Memory fragments to rebuild the mind’s creative foundation.

The more you restore, the more the world opens, leading you closer to becoming something greater than a thought… an idea.

data.short_description: You are a sentient creative thought, in a A 3D Open World exploration based platformer. Restore color to a unique world set in the human mind. Uncover memories hidden beneath the surface and discover the mystery to how the mind ended up in this state.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-4460 / AMD Ryzen 3 1200
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 750 Ti / AMD Radeon RX 560
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Dedicated GPU recommended; integrated graphics may run the game at reduced performance depending on reveal effects and map rendering.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 / AMD Ryzen 5 2600
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1060 / AMD Radeon RX 580
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 8 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: SSD recommended for best load times and smoother streaming of assets.
